claims.supporting_quote: VX-770 also increased Cl(-) secretion in cultured human CF bronchial epithelia (HBE) carrying the G551D gating mutation
claims.text: In cultured human bronchial epithelia carrying the G551D gating mutation on one allele and the F508del processing mutation on the other, VX-770 increased chloride secretion by approximately 10-fold, to approximately 50 percent of the level seen in epithelia from individuals without cystic fibrosis.

claims.supporting_quote: the median change in the level of sweat chloride was -59.5 mmol per liter
claims.text: In a Phase 2 study of 39 adults with cystic fibrosis and at least one G551D-CFTR allele, subjects who received 150 mg of VX-770 for 28 days had a median change in sweat chloride of -59.5 mmol per liter.

disease: Cystic fibrosis with the G551D-CFTR gating mutation
target: CFTR (cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator), G551D gating mutation
